limits: Windows PowerShell native implementation; no Bash/Zsh/fish or source sentinel fallback when OSC integration cannot initialize. Startup fails closed after10s.
PowerShell completion follows source success/failure0/1 policy; inspect LASTEXITCODE explicitly for native subprocess codes.
Native policy currently Always Ask/Always Allow. Source Smart shell command classifier is not implemented. Owned create/kill bypass approval; command/stdin/poll/watcher use current policy.
Dynamic current full manifest is implemented; source environment snapshot revision/delta history representation is not reproduced.
Watchers use the same interactive native session and stop it on completion; source stages a temporary watcher script. Both are process-local; durable process restart is not claimed.
Regex uses bounded PCRE2 rather than JavaScript RegExp; syntax and edge behavior can differ.

Native bounds:32 retained exited sessions/chat with200 history rows each, plus up to5 active sessions,64KiB command/stdin,256KiB pending input,1MiB UTF8 match tail,64KiB display preview,16KiB streamed grid snapshot,head100/tail300 result lines. Logs independently cap50MiB plus marker.
Borrowed viewer retains service120x24 grid and uses scrollbars; it does not resize shared model/process.
Environment sanitization is a source-derived key-name heuristic, not proof all possible encoded credentials are absent. Shell commands retain user OS permissions and are not a filesystem sandbox.
No live provider keys or external service actions used; tests use loopback provider fixtures and dedicated temporary workspace directories.
Offscreen Qt emitted font-directory warning; fixture loads packaged Roboto Mono and the final screenshot was visually inspected readable.
Focused passing checks establish exercised behavior, not complete parity or universal defect absence.

Pinned source retains exited session records but disposes its headless terminal in SessionLogger.close(); native retains a bounded200-row recent grid so borrowed exit views remain readable, pruning beyond32. This is an explicit native retention choice.

questionCapabilityPolicy.nativeDefault: Disabled in standalone/headless AgentEngine; setQuestionToolEnabled(true) is an idle-only opt-in.
questionCapabilityPolicy.gui: MainWindow explicitly enables structured questions for its chat engines.
questionCapabilityPolicy.disabledBehavior: askUserQuestions is omitted from tool definitions; unsolicited calls return a tool error instead of waiting for a nonexistent form. An opt-in attempted during an active turn has no effect.
questionCapabilityPolicy.regression: headlessQuestionsAreNotAdvertisedOrWaitedOn covers OpenAI-compatible chat, Responses, Anthropic and Google; existing explicit question completion cases retain exact provider associations.
